concerns.text: The specification assumes the availability of public WCST datasets that include a 'stimulus_type' column distinguishing nostalgia vs. control conditions (US1/FR-001). No such dataset is known to exist, so the primary hypothesis cannot be empirically tested with real data. Using a deterministic synthetic data generator (as the implementation plan currently proposes) would make the predictor (nostalgia assignment) and the outcome (WCST metrics) co‑generated, rendering the validation target dependent on the predictor and creating a circular, non‑independent validation. This violates scientific independence and makes the study design unsound.
